faq.q: What is the best alternative to the Stoic app?
faq.a: It depends on what you use Stoic for. For an evening conversation, a meditation made from your day and a memory you can edit, Auserene (iPhone only). For a long archive on every device, Day One. For AI journaling on Android and the web, Rosebud or Reflection. For quick mood tracking, Daylio. For a short gratitude routine, the Five Minute Journal. For free and private, Apple Journal.

Apps like Stoic include Auserene, Day One, Rosebud, Reflection, Daylio, the Five Minute Journal, Mindsera and Apple Journal. They share daily journaling and some form of mood or habit tracking, and differ on AI, meditation, streaks, platforms and price.

faq.q: Is there a journal app with meditation besides Stoic?
faq.a: Yes. Auserene writes a guided meditation from each day's evening conversation and has eight guided meditation journeys and 11 ambient sounds. Day One, Rosebud, Reflection, Daylio, the Five Minute Journal, Mindsera and Apple Journal don't list meditation on the pages we checked.

faq.q: Is there a Stoic app free version?
faq.a: Yes. Stoic's free plan includes daily prompts, quotes, affirmations, basic guided journals and a limited set of breathing and meditation exercises, and its web app is free. Premium and Premium + AI are paid.

faq.q: How much does the Stoic app cost?
faq.a: Stoic's website doesn't list prices. As of November 2026, its App Store listing shows Premium purchases from $6.99 to $39.99, AI purchases at $12.99, $69.99 and $99.99, and Lifetime Premium at $299, without stating billing periods. Trials are seven days for Premium and three for Premium + AI, on annual plans only.

faq.q: Is there a Stoic journal alternative without streaks?
faq.a: Auserene has no streaks; its habit goals have a 21, 42 or 64-day finish line and never mark a missed day red. Stoic also lets you turn streaks and badges off on its badges screen.

informationGain: A November 19, 2026 comparison of eight Stoic app alternatives where every competitor fact links to that company's own page, covering Stoic's App Store prices that carry no billing periods, which apps include meditation (only Stoic's library and Auserene's meditation written from your day), which keep streaks, and which run on Android.
